Admission for 2026/2027

Applications open October 1, 2026.

Admission Requirements

  • Nursery: Age 3+ | Birth certificate
  • Primary: Transfer letter + last term report
  • JSS1: Common Entrance + Interview
  • SS1: BECE results + Placement test

How to Apply

  1. Get form online or at school office — ₦5,000
  2. Submit documents + write entrance exam
  3. Admission letter sent within 1 week
